context:
Goal: a lane fixes a small finding after review and merges, without repeat reviews that add nothing and without a record that hides a failed check.
Problem (rule): today a record holds one fix check, so a second small fix forces a fresh review chain. Tonight that sent many PRs back for full rounds. #1829 lets fix checks chain after a passed one, which changes your ruling.
Based on (ruling): your typed go of 2026-11-05 07:45 CST (commit a89fdc05e, decision pr-review-record) set the one-fix-check limit. Asked again because tonight's queue shows the cost of a fresh chain each time, which that ruling did not weigh.
Based on (measured): #1829's round 3 (reviewer sonnet) passed with net value zero at f812874cd. Tonight one PR (#1892) needed two more small fixes after a passed fix check, so a chain would have saved 2 review rounds on 1 PR. No other PR tonight needed a chain (coordinator, 06:39 CST). Later, on #1471, a fix check failed only because a `Drops-lines:` line named the wrong commit (df5a181c2, not ad1f43bd5); the code was right, yet the one-fix-check limit means a fresh rounds 1-3 chain (lane notes-fix-page, coordinator 07:58 CST Nov 8). On #1893, a fix check failed only because the brief's allowed-token list left out STALE010, a rename the brief itself ordered; no defect is open, yet the limit forces a fresh rounds 1-3 chain (lane record-claim-cites-code, coordinator 08:48 CST Nov 8).
Departs from: decision pr-review-record, one fix check per record — allows a chain of fix checks, each on the diff since the last passed one.
Meanwhile: #1829 is held from runner 8; other lanes keep the fresh-chain rule.

options.gain: Small fixes after review merge after one short check each, so fewer full review rounds.
options.how: #1829 merges. After a passed fix check, the next small fix gets its own fix check on the diff since that pass. Decision pr-review-record is rewritten in place.
options.label: Allow chained fix checks (merge #1829)
options.lose: A long chain of small checks can drift from the reviewed whole; no full read after the first.

options.gain: Every merged head has had one whole-diff read since its last real change.
options.how: #1829 closes. A second fix after a passed fix check starts a fresh review chain.
options.label: Keep one fix check, then a fresh chain (today's rule)
options.lose: More full review rounds, at haiku and sonnet cost.

ref: #1829 (lane fail-record-ancestor-head, session_013NEJKzYhDtNPLcEdeVFEVe); decision pr-review-record; step fix-check-chain
short: Chain fix checks, or keep one per record
title: May fix checks chain after a passed one, or does a second small fix still start a fresh review chain?
